info.title: outwit-resolve — fetch and stage controller data assets per manifest.
info.description: CLI for OutWit.Engine.Assets — resolves and stages controller data assets (Blender, FFmpeg, datasets, ...) declared by controller.json manifests. Used during WitCloud Docker image builds to bake required binaries into server storage.

options.name: --platforms
options.description:
Comma-separated runtime identifiers to resolve assets for.
Default: the current machine's RID.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to a controller.json manifest. May be specified multiple times.

options.name: --output
options.description: Root directory where <name>.module/ subdirectories will be written.
